question: In the majority of immunocompetent individuals exposed to Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primary infection is contained and the bacilli remain dormant in a latent state without causing active disease.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is actually true. Most primary TB infections are successfully contained by the cell-mediated immune response. Active disease follows only when the balance tips — typically due to HIV, malnutrition, diabetes, or corticosteroid use.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Approximately 90–95% of immunocompetent people contain primary TB infection, entering a latent state. Only 5–10% develop active TB in their lifetime, usually during periods of immune compromise.
